scope: Scene launch/stop timing and requested/queued/active feedback on a general session, including refused and rejected requests
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none, silent preview clock
verified_behaviors: general-session-regressions: four tracks at 137 BPM (non-integral bars) with identical samples at blocks 1/64/128/257/512, Immediate sparse replacement releasing MIDI voices, scene stop at bar 3, saturation and panic recovery
One bar launch while playing: 'Launch requested' (all four tracks requested) until acknowledged, then 'Stopped · actions queued' (every track 'Launch queued'), then 'Active' with all four clips
Immediate replacement by a two-track scene keeps tracks 1 and 4 and stops 2 and 3 in the same block
Full control queue: the scene request is refused with 'Control queue full' and no scene reads 'requested'
Engine action queue full (64 queued launches): a four-track scene is rejected as a whole; the request clears, the message reports the rejection, tracks 2-4 stay 'Stopped' and none is active
Panic recovers and the same scene launches; unknown scenes and policies are refused without requested state
limits: Silent preview clock and offscreen platform; the earlier private-graph capture is in scene-controls.json; no physical audio.
